Subject: Alder Systems — onboarding details: legal entity, remittance & PO contact

Hi Sara —

Thanks for the demo last week. We're ready to enable Alder Systems as an approved vendor in Redwood's procurement system so we can raise the first PO for the integration work. To complete vendor master creation and get PO/payment routing in place, can you please confirm the following (attach any PDFs you have):

- Legal company name as it should appear on invoices and POs
- Legal entity type and registered country
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT if non-US)
- Registered address and remit-to address (if different)
- Preferred PO contact (name, email, phone)
- AP remittance method (ACH / wire / check) and banking contact for payment set-up
- If you require a purchase order number to be on invoices and whether your AR team needs any specific invoice fields

I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist and a sample remittance form for reference. If you can return a completed W-9 (or equivalent), we can expedite the vendor code creation. Our standard payment term is NET30 unless we've agreed otherwise in SOW.

Next steps: once we have the documents I will hand off to AP (Marissa) and Karthik (who owns ERP mappings) to create the vendor record and map PO routing.

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we're aiming to issue PO #RWD-2147 by end of next week.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Manager, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: alder_procurement_checklist.xlsx (procurement intake), vendor_profile_template.docx (form)

Great, thank you Sara — this is exactly what we need. Quick clarification items before I route to AP:

1) For ACH we only need the bank name, routing number, and account number in DocuSign or a secure portal. You can send via DocuSign link (the HubSpot deal includes a request for signed banking authorization if that's easier).
2) For the remit-to address: do you prefer that we send a remittance advice email to ap@alder-sys.com or to tom.reyes@alder-sys.com? We'll add the remit-to contact in the vendor master.
3) Confirm that invoices should be sent to ap@alder-sys.com and include "PO RWD-2147" once generated.

If all good, I'll ask Marissa to open the vendor profile in our ERP and Karthik to set the PO routing rules (ERP vendor code, default pay term NET30, ACH routing).

Thanks again — we should be able to generate the PO within 48 hours of the DocuSign/secure bank details arriving.

Best,
Marcus
